ui_bugs.issue: Console SyntaxError on page load: `Pattern attribute value [0-9+ -]* is not a valid regular expression`. Cause: unescaped hyphen inside character class is parsed as a range. Fix: change pattern to `[0-9+ \-]*` or `[-0-9+ ]*` (move `-` to start/end of class). Does not block save but browsers will refuse to validate the field.

critical_code_review_comments: server.js:1047-1057 medicalbill/save stock verification loops with a shared `stockError` variable across parallel async callbacks — race-safe here only because SQLite serializes on one connection, but semantically fragile. Better: use Promise.all for stock check.

server.js:1357-1363 pending-medicines DELETE uses MAX(current_stock - qty, 0) which silently clamps to zero — if pending qty exceeds physical stock the operator has no signal. Consider logging a warning row or returning the delta in the response.

server.js:1683-1704 monthly-summary uses `${month}-31` as an upper bound which is technically valid in SQLite string comparison but sloppy for months <31 days. Use date('now') / strftime end-of-month for correctness in edge cases.
server.js:822-826 POST /api/suppliers returns 200 even when body has no supplier_name (upsertSupplier silently returns null id). Consider a 400 on empty name so the UI can react.

rca of the issue: No functional bugs found in the 7-batch. Only nit: suppliers.html phone-input regex is invalid (`[0-9+ -]*`). Root cause: unescaped hyphen inside a character class in an HTML5 pattern attribute makes the browser treat ` -]` as a range from space (0x20) to `]` (0x5D). Fix: `pattern="[0-9+ \-]*"` or move hyphen to end/start of class. Impact: browser refuses to run the pattern validation (throws SyntaxError, logged in console); the field itself still saves because we only rely on server-side storage. Cosmetic/DX bug only.
